svg.title: The structure and responsibilities of the ATRL atelier
svg.desc: The atelier operator and responsible editor, Human Lead, sets editorial direction, organizes the two teams, and holds priorities, authority and final responsibility. Individual article planners contribute questions, readers and prompting through planning exchanges. Human Audit records actual review scope. The map retains the existing AEDAUT/ADOPT cooperation, authority and record routes, Proseeker within ADOPT, the shared harness and publication through existing editorial delegation.
